item.title: Jefferies’ Chris Wood sees a structural bear market in US bonds. What it means for stocks and gold
item.description: Jefferies warned that persistent pressure on US Treasury yields could create a challenging environment for equity markets, particularly for bond-sensitive assets such as REITs. While higher yields have weighed on Singapore REITs, the brokerage sees selective opportunities in the sector and remains constructive on gold and gold-mining stocks as a hedge against potential dollar debasement.

item.title: US Market: J.P. Morgan, BNP Paribas expect ECB rate hike in December as inflation risks persist
item.description: J.P. Morgan and BNP Paribas now expect the European Central Bank to deliver another 25-basis-point rate hike in December, reversing their earlier calls for the tightening cycle to end without a December increase. Persistent inflation risks, elevated energy prices and resilient economic growth are driving the shift, while markets are already pricing in a near-certain 25-basis-point hike at the ECB’s September meeting.

item.title: Value stocks are making a comeback in India. These 10 stocks could benefit
item.description: India’s value-stock universe is showing signs of recovery after a sharp decline during the previous bull run. ICICI Securities has identified 10 stocks, led by Vedanta, ONGC and Indian Oil, that meet its value criteria based on earnings yield, return on equity, valuations, earnings trends and potential catalysts.

item.title: JM Financial initiates coverage on OnEMI Technology with Buy call, sees 28% upside
item.description: JM Financial has initiated coverage on OnEMI Technology Solutions with a Buy rating and a target price of Rs 385, implying around 28% upside from its reference price of Rs 301. The brokerage values the stock at 2x estimated FY28 book value, citing its digital lending platform Kissht and mass-market borrower focus.

item.title: Inside Tesla’s Cybercab push: Can Robotaxis power the next stock rally?
item.description: Tesla shares rallied more than 5% ahead of the company’s closely watched Cybercab event in Austin, as investors focused on its robotaxi ambitions. The two-seat autonomous vehicle, designed without a steering wheel or pedals, is central to Tesla’s plans to scale its robotaxi network, although pricing, competition and regulatory hurdles remain key concerns.

item.title: US Fed rate cut bets fall below 50% after Governor Chris Waller’s comments. What did he say?
item.description: Expectations of a US Federal Reserve rate cut at its September 16 meeting have weakened sharply, with traders now pricing in less than a 50% chance of a reduction, according to CME FedWatch data. Comments from Fed officials, including Christopher Waller and Kevin Warsh, have reinforced uncertainty over the policy path, while elevated global bond yields and inflation concerns continue to weigh on markets.

item.title: Is AI boom hiding growing US risks? Nomura warns dollar asset concentration leaves global markets vulnerable to AI shocks
item.description: Nomura warned that the AI boom may be masking growing US risks, as heavy global exposure to dollar assets leaves markets vulnerable to an AI-driven shock. The brokerage said a setback in AI could trigger a sharp correction in US equities, weaken the dollar and potentially turn into a broader global risk-off event.

item.title: Which stocks should you buy ahead of the festive season? Here are Kotak Securities’ top 10 picks
item.description: India’s festive season is expected to drive a strong consumption boost, with analysts identifying sectors and stocks that could benefit. The period from Ganesh Chaturthi through Navratri, Dussehra, Dhanteras, Diwali and the wedding season typically brings higher footfalls, orders, ticket sizes and margins.

item.title: Global Market: China stocks rebound, but weekly loss looms as AI rally cools
item.description: China’s mainland stocks gained on Friday, but major benchmarks remained on track for weekly losses as fading momentum in AI shares and elevated US Treasury yields weighed on sentiment. The CSI300 and Shanghai Composite rose 0.4%, while Hong Kong’s Hang Seng advanced 2.1%, led by a rebound in technology stocks.

item.title: India bonds pause before weekly debt supply
item.description: Indian government bond yields remained steady on Friday morning, with traders eyeing an impending debt sale that could reveal market demand. The recent stabilization of oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields is providing some influence on local markets. Banks are strategizing to cope with surplus liquidity, as ongoing global risks and inflation worries cast a shadow over bond market stability.

item.title: Global Market: JGB yields extend fall as stronger yen, hawkish BOJ outlook lift sentiment
item.description: Japanese government bond yields extended their decline on Friday as a stronger yen and expectations of a hawkish Bank of Japan stance lifted sentiment. The benchmark 10-year JGB yield fell 5.5 basis points to 2.91%. Shifting US rate expectations also weighed on Treasury yields and supported the yen.

item.title: Global Market: Japan stocks rebound on Wall Street boost, SoftBank rally
item.description: Japan’s Nikkei rebounded on Friday, snapping a four-session losing streak, as a rally in SoftBank Group and gains on Wall Street lifted sentiment. However, the benchmark remained on track for a third straight weekly decline amid expectations of further Bank of Japan rate hikes and continued pressure on Japanese equities.

item.title: IFCI shares rally 6% as NSE IPO buzz lifts sentiment; stock gains 35% in a month
item.description: IFCI Share Price: IFCI shares surged over 6% as optimism around the long-awaited NSE IPO boosted investor interest in the state-owned financial services company, which indirectly holds more than 4% of NSE through SHCIL. The stock has rallied nearly 35% in a month, while NSE’s potential IPO valuation and regulatory risks remain key factors for investors.

item.title: Robinhood stock surges: Why HOOD is rallying and what Wall Street sees next
item.description: Robinhood shares surged as analysts raised targets, citing prediction markets, crypto strength and business diversification. Expanding financial services and upcoming sports-event trading could drive growth, although elevated valuation and volatility remain key concerns for investors.

item.title: Gold prices fall Rs 2,100/10 gram after 2 days; silver down Rs 1,500/kg ahead of US payrolls data. Important levels for today
item.description: Following a brief rally, gold and silver prices opened lower on Friday, sparking caution among investors. The market is now focused on the US payrolls report, which may provide insights into Federal Reserve interest rate decisions. Geopolitical concerns in the Middle East are another pivotal factor affecting prices. Experts warn of potential volatility in the precious metals market and recommend long-term investment strategies.

item.title: ESDS Software shares skyrocket 112% from IPO price as stock soars 20% after bumper debut. Should you buy, sell or wait?
item.description: ESDS Share Price: ESDS Software Solution shares more than doubled from their IPO price shortly after listing, hitting the 20% upper circuit following a blockbuster debut. With the stock’s sharp gains pushing valuations higher, analysts have outlined strategies for IPO allottees and investors who missed the issue, including profit-booking and entry levels.

item.title: Sterlite Tech shares hit 5% upper circuit as firm targets Rs 20,000 crore revenue by FY29 amid booming AI demand
item.description: Sterlite Technologies shares hit a 5% upper circuit after unveiling ambitious FY29 growth targets, including Rs 20,000 crore revenue and global top-five positioning. The company approved Rs 3,000 crore capex to expand capacity by 50%, supported by strong optical connectivity demand, AI infrastructure growth and a record order book.

item.title: PhysicsWallah shares surge over 4% after Motilal Oswal initiates coverage with Buy rating. Should you buy?
item.description: PhysicsWallah shares surged over 4% after Motilal Oswal initiated coverage with a ‘Buy’ rating and a Rs 200 target price, implying about 66% upside. The brokerage highlighted the company’s capital-efficient model, strong online presence and scalable offline network, while projecting revenue and EBITDA growth through FY28 and flagging competition, execution and AI-related risks.

item.title: IEX shares rise 2% after electricity trading volume jumps 20% YoY to hit record high in August
item.description: IEX shares rose on Friday after the exchange reported record monthly electricity trading volume of 13,938 MUs in August, up 20.2% year-on-year. Higher power demand lifted Day-Ahead Market buy bids, while prices also increased. However, REC volumes fell sharply amid lower participation, declining 86.6% year-on-year during the month.

item.title: US Market: Rising R-star adds to pressure on US Treasury yields as AI investment, borrowing lift demand for capital
item.description: US Treasury yields are rising partly on expectations that R-star, the economy’s neutral interest rate, may be structurally higher. Heavy government borrowing and AI investment are boosting capital demand, potentially keeping rates elevated longer. A higher R-star could limit Federal Reserve rate cuts, pressure Treasury prices and increase borrowing costs across the economy.

item.title: Ceigall India shares gain 4% after securing LoI for Rs 5,300 crore power transmission project
item.description: Ceigall India shares rose nearly 4% after the company received a Letter of Intent from REC Power Development and Consultancy for a Rs 5,300 crore power transmission project in Gujarat. The project includes a 765/400 kV AIS substation and around 300 km of transmission lines, with 36 months of execution followed by a 35-year operational period and annual transmission charges of Rs 608.67 crore.

item.title: BSE, Groww, Angel One shares rally up to 8% after Sebi’s CAS circular. What did the regulator say?
item.description: Sebi plans to review the methodology for setting derivative settlement prices on expiry after market participants raised concerns over the new Closing Auction Session (CAS). The regulator will issue a consultation paper next week.

item.title: Global Market: Four US firms commit $2 billion investment in South Korea
item.description: Four U.S. companies have committed $2 billion in South Korea across semiconductors, advanced materials and renewable energy. Investments include semiconductor gases, chip equipment, advanced glass and a 3.2-GW offshore wind project. The commitments strengthen South Korea’s efforts to attract foreign investment and deepen economic cooperation with the United States.

Polycab, KEI Industries shares crash up to 9% after UltraTech Cement enters wires & cables business. What Jefferies, Nuvama expect
item.description: Shares of Polycab and KEI Industries fell sharply after UltraTech Cement launched its ₹1,800 crore wires and cables business, Ultravolt. Brokerages warned that the Aditya Birla Group’s aggressive entry could trigger near-term de-rating across the cables and wires sector, although Nuvama retained Polycab and KEI as its top picks.

item.title: Eicher Motors Share Price Live Updates: Eicher Motors News
Global Market: South Korean shares rise on chip gains, KOSPI set for third weekly loss
item.description: South Korean shares rose 0.85% on Friday, led by gains in heavyweight chipmakers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, although the KOSPI remained on track for its third consecutive weekly decline amid elevated bond yields.

item.title: Large trade alert! Gland Pharma shares fall 3% after 1.2 crore shares change hands in 2 block deals; promoter Fosun likely seller
item.description: Gland Pharma shares fell 3% after 1.22 crore shares changed hands in two block deals worth nearly Rs 5,818 crore. Promoter Fosun Pharma Industrial was reportedly looking to sell a 5% stake for Rs 2,279.5 crore. Meanwhile, the company’s recent USFDA inspection of two Visakhapatnam facilities concluded with zero Form 483 observations.

item.title: Eternal, ICICI Bank, 5 other largecap stocks with upside potential of up to 40%. Do you own any?
item.description: India's IPO market is expected to surpass last year's record fundraising. A strong second-half revival and potential mega issues will drive this growth. Jio Platforms and NSE IPOs could significantly boost total fundraising figures. Improved listing performance and investor demand are supporting the primary market. The market's deepening reflects structural growth rather than a short-term cycle.

item.title: Sensex rallies 700 points tracking Asian peers, Nifty nears 24,000. What lies ahead?
item.description: On Friday, Indian stock markets experienced a notable upswing, reflecting the positive trends seen in Asian markets following a series of downturns. Sensex and Nifty indices posted impressive gains, complemented by a rise in broader market activity. This upward momentum is bolstered by encouraging economic indicators such as GST collections and credit growth.

item.title: Paluck Technologies, Complete Sports and Management SME shares to list today: GMP signals diverging sentiment
item.description: Paluck Technologies, Complete Sports and Management India are set to debut on the BSE SME platform today, showing sharply contrasting grey market signals.

item.title: REC set to debut tokenised corporate bond sale next week: Bankers
item.description: India will launch tokenized corporate bonds next week using blockchain technology. State-run REC aims to raise five billion rupees through these innovative debt instruments. This marks India's first debt issue with instant settlement capabilities on a blockchain. The Reserve Bank of India's digital currency will facilitate these bond transactions. Only investors with active digital wallets can participate in this upcoming sale.

item.title: HAL shares rise nearly 3% as GE Aerospace delivers 3 more F404 engines for Tejas Mk1A
item.description: HAL shares rose nearly 3% after GE Aerospace delivered three F404-IN20 engines in August for India’s LCA Tejas Mk1A programme. The deliveries come amid prolonged supply delays, as HAL works to fulfil Indian Air Force orders for 180 Mk1A fighters. HAL currently has an annual production capacity of 24 aircraft, with engine supplies critical to ramping up production.

item.title: Will 2026 be India's biggest IPO year? Slow H1 may not stop record Rs 2 lakh crore haul
item.description: India's IPO market is expected to surpass last year's record fundraising. A strong second-half revival and potential mega issues will drive this growth. Jio Platforms and NSE IPOs could significantly boost total fundraising figures. Improved listing performance and investor demand are supporting the primary market. The market's deepening reflects structural growth rather than a short-term cycle.

item.title: Tata Chemicals shares fall 3% after Kenya orders end to operations. Here’s why
item.description: Tata Chemicals reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 17 crore in the June 2026 quarter, compared with a profit of Rs 252 crore a year earlier. Revenue rose 14.4% to Rs 4,255 crore, supported by higher volumes, but EBITDA fell 14.5% amid weaker overseas realisations. Shares have declined 15% in 2026 and over 30% in the past year.

item.title: Reliance shares are down 17% despite soaring refining margins. What the market is missing
item.description: Despite strong refining and petrochemical margins, Reliance shares have experienced a dip as the market focuses on long-term growth potential. Investors are keenly anticipating signs of recovery in Reliance Retail and progress in New Energy initiatives. A significant concern remains the company's capability to generate free cash flow, with analysts indicating that the stock's valuation is closely tied to its future business performance.

item.title: Rays of Belief IPO allotment likely today: GMP signals 5% listing gain. Here’s how to check status
item.description: Rays of Belief IPO allotment is expected to be finalised today, September 4, after the Rs 125 crore issue was subscribed 107.71 times. The company is set to list on both BSE and NSE on September 8.

item.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk | Nifty at 20.5x is not expensive; smallcaps are where valuations worry us: Pradeep Gupta
item.description: With the Nifty trading at around 20.5 times earnings — nearly 12% below its 10-year average — Gupta argues that the broader market is not expensive, especially at a time when corporate earnings are accelerating and upgrades are outpacing downgrades.

item.title: ​Finolex Cables among 4 stocks flashing bullish signals, hinting at a possible uptrend
item.description: Four Nifty500 stocks showed strong bullish momentum on September 3, forming White Marubozu candlestick patterns that indicated sustained buying pressure and buyers maintaining control throughout the trading session.

item.title: Deepa Jewellers IPO allotment likely today: GMP signals 11% listing gain. Here’s how to check status
item.description: The Deepa Jewellers IPO is likely to finalise its allotment today after receiving an overwhelming 42.61 times subscription. With a current GMP of around 11%, investors are awaiting the allotment status ahead of the company’s September 8 listing on the BSE and NSE.

item.title: Block deal alert! Gland Pharma shares fall 3% as 1.2 crore shares change hands in 2 block deals; promoter Fosun likely seller
item.description: Gland Pharma shares fell after a significant block deal involving Fosun Pharma Industrial. The company's VSEZ facility received zero USFDA observations after a recent inspection. Gland Pharma reported strong Q1FY27 results with increased profit and revenue. Its CDMO and B2B businesses showed substantial year-on-year growth. The pharma stock has gained significantly year-to-date.

item.title: HDFC Bank Share Price Live Updates: India's balance of payments likely to post $60-65 bn surplus in FY27 despite wider CAD: HDFC Bank
Qualiance International SME IPO opens today: GMP signals 43% listing gain — Check key details
item.description: Qualiance International’s Rs 45.11-crore SME IPO opens September 4, with a 43% grey-market premium indicating strong listing expectations. The issue will fund a new Tiruppur manufacturing facility. FY26 revenue rose 47% and profit surged 142%, highlighting strong financial growth. Shares are expected to debut on the NSE SME platform on September 11.

item.title: Anant Raj among 4 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
item.description: On September 3, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 5% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from below, indicating strengthening price momentum and potential upward movement in the stocks.

item.title: Hot Stocks: 3 stocks that may give returns between 19-34%
item.description: Brokerages have recently begun coverage on Adani Ports, Welspun Corp, and Wakefit Innovations, all receiving buy ratings. Analysts project price targets indicating potential gains ranging from nineteen to thirty-four percent. Adani Power is anticipated to excel due to India's forthcoming thermal capacity expansions, while Welspun Corp stands to gain from increased investments in oil and gas infrastructure.
